_doc: Civilian traffic density vs time of day, relative to the daytime peak (1.0). Read by wp_world::density (embedded at build time). hourly[i] is the value at i:00, linear in between; each district multiplies it by its own district_mul row (same interpolation; 1.0 = follows the curve). Downtown (Core) keeps nightlife until ~02:00 and then drops into the same trough (noon >= 5x 03:00); industrial, port and suburbs are emptier at night; by day every district follows the curve. Results are clamped to 0..1. Owner playtest row 76 (target bands: 01-05 ~15-20 %, 23:00 ~35 %, 19-22 ~60 %, 07-09 and 16-19 100 %, midday ~75 %).
